about_the_game:
🌿 A mischievous spirit summoner’s chaotic journey to reclaim her forest friends!

In a quiet village of spirit summoners, trouble has arrived.
While the elders were away, a sinister group kidnapped the village’s guardian spirits.
Now it’s up to Yuna, the most unlikely and mischievous apprentice, to step up and save them all.

🎮 Key Features

  • A 2D metroidvania platformer where combat and puzzles revolve around elemental spirits

  • Yuna has no basic attack — every action is done through the spirits she collects

  • Use elemental advantages to solve challenges:
    burn wooden obstacles with fire spirits, put out enemies with water spirits, and more

  • Cute pixel art visuals with a magical, atmospheric forest setting

  • Designed for exploration and elemental interaction, not twitch-based combat

🔮 Perfect for fans of:

  • Platformers and metroidvania-style progression

  • Puzzle-action games with a twist in mechanics

  • Wholesome, pixel art adventures with a fantasy tone

  • Collecting and using unique abilities for creative solutions

📌 Current Status

The game is currently in development, and a demo version is now available!

Add it to your wishlist and start exploring the forest with Yuna today.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 2200G or Intel Core i3-6100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 350 MB available space

short_description: A 2D pixel-art metroidvania where you fight using elemental spirits instead of basic attacks. Explore, collect, and solve puzzles in a magical forest.
supported_languages:
English, Japanese, Korean*, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support
